answer.likely_cause: A header line added to the proxy's configuration for this app made the proxy stop telling the app that browsers connect over HTTPS, so the app, which only accepts HTTPS, redirects every request to the HTTPS address the browser is already on.

evidence.line: 2026-10-26 22:12:44,141 INFO oidc-rp event=force_https path=/ scheme=http x_forwarded_proto=-
evidence.why: The app thinks the request was plain HTTP, as indicated by `scheme=http` and `x_forwarded_proto=-`.

evidence.line: 172.30.182.10 - - [26/Oct/2026:22:12:45 +0000] "GET / HTTP/1.1" 302 235 "-" "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/153.0.8010.12 Safari/537.36"
evidence.why: The proxy logs a 302 from the app for each redirect attempt.

fix_steps: Make the location send the forwarded headers again by either taking the extra line out or repeating every header the location needs.
answer.customer_reply: We believe the issue is due to a header line added to the proxy's configuration for the Northgate Expenses app, which has caused the proxy to stop informing the app that browsers are connecting over HTTPS. As a result, the app is redirecting every request to the HTTPS address, leading to a redirect loop. We recommend checking the proxy configuration and ensuring that the forwarded headers are correctly set. Please confirm if this matches your situation.
questions_for_customer: Does the issue occur for every user and on every page before any login? Does a private window or another browser behave the same?
